questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In simple harmonic motion, the acceleration of the particle is:
options: Proportional to displacement and directed towards the mean position
Proportional to displacement and directed away from the mean position
questions.explanation: a = -ω²x, so the acceleration grows with displacement and always points back towards the mean position, which is what makes the motion oscillatory.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The drift velocity of free electrons in a metallic conductor carrying an ordinary current is of the order of:
questions.explanation: Drift velocity is only about a fraction of a millimetre per second; current appears instantly because the electric field is set up along the wire at nearly the speed of light.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In Young's double slit experiment, if monochromatic light is replaced by white light, the central fringe appears:
options: White, with coloured fringes on either side
questions.explanation: At the centre the path difference is zero for every wavelength, so all colours reinforce and give a white fringe, flanked by coloured maxima.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A process occurring at constant temperature and pressure is spontaneous when:
questions.explanation: ΔG = ΔH - TΔS. A negative ΔG means the process is spontaneous, while ΔG = 0 indicates equilibrium.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The coordination number of cobalt in the complex [Co(NH₃)₆]Cl₃ is:
questions.explanation: Coordination number counts the ligand donor atoms bonded directly to the metal. Six ammonia molecules are in the coordination sphere, so it is 6.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The half-life of a first order reaction with rate constant k is given by:
questions.explanation: For a first order reaction t½ = ln2/k = 0.693/k, which is independent of the initial concentration.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The light reactions of photosynthesis take place in the:
questions.explanation: Photosystems and the electron transport chain sit in the thylakoid membranes, while the carbon fixing dark reactions occur in the stroma.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 11: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which of the following is an example of in-situ conservation of biodiversity?
questions.explanation: In-situ conservation protects species in their own habitat, as in biosphere reserves, national parks and sanctuaries. The other options are ex-situ methods.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 13: Biodiversity and Conservation

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Oxytocin and vasopressin are released from which part of the pituitary gland?
questions.explanation: Both hormones are actually synthesised in the hypothalamus and are only stored in and released from the neurohypophysis or posterior pituitary.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 19: Chemical Coordination and Integration

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The protection a newborn gets from the antibodies present in the mother's colostrum is an example of:
questions.explanation: Ready-made IgA antibodies are transferred to the infant rather than produced by it, so the immunity is passive and short lived.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease
